concept.title: Reference Topic
concept.shortdesc: A reference topic presents lookup data such as parameter tables, API fields, or configuration options

conbody.p: A reference topic presents lookup data such as parameter tables, API fields, or configuration options that a user consults. The converter classifies a section as reference when the body is dominated by tables or parameter lists, or when the heading contains keywords such as reference, API, parameter, schema, or syntax.

The generated topic uses <reference> with <refbody>, and table routing is determined by structure: a 2-column table in an API context maps to <properties>, a captioned or merged-cell table maps to CALS <table> + <tgroup>, and any other multi-column table maps to <simpletable>.
